one_liner: Source-available C++ mesh-processing SDK whose triangle-mesh booleans run tens of times faster than CGAL's exact booleans.
what_it_does: MeshLib is a 3D geometry SDK covering mesh booleans, repair, decimation, remeshing, offsets, SDF/voxel conversion, point-cloud triangulation and ICP, with C++, C, Python, C# and JavaScript/WASM bindings. Booleans are one call, MR::boolean(meshA, meshB, MR::BooleanOperation::Union|Intersection|DifferenceAB|..., params). It returns a BooleanResult that you check with valid()/errorString, plus an optional mapper from new faces back to the input faces. It is not a drop-in for CGAL: it uses its own half-edge MR::Mesh type rather than Surface_mesh/Polyhedron_3, and also offers a voxel-based boolean mode for messy input.
how_it_is_fast: It works in floating point on a half-edge mesh. Degenerate configurations are handled by exact predicates (orient3d) on coordinates converted to integers, with Simulation of Simplicity (Edelsbrunner-Mücke) breaking ties. This avoids CGAL's rational/lazy-exact arithmetic, which the vendor blames for CGAL being 10-100x slower and hanging on near-coplanar faces. The work runs multi-threaded by default (the benchmark used default threading on a 10-core M5), and an AABB tree for intersection search is built once as pre-computation.
when_to_use: Booleans on large scanned triangle meshes (10^5 to several 10^6 triangles), where CGAL takes seconds or hangs: 0.09 s vs CGAL's 4.4 s on a 2M-triangle union in the vendor benchmark
Inputs with many near-coplanar faces or degeneracies (dental/medical scans) that make exact-arithmetic CGAL stall
Non-commercial, academic or evaluation work, or a team prepared to buy the commercial licence
Pipelines that also need repair, decimation, offsetting or voxel/SDF operations from the same SDK, from C++, Python or C#
when_not_to_use: Commercial or redistributed software without a paid licence: the LICENSE grants only a terminable non-commercial/evaluation/educational licence and forbids modification and transfer
Work that needs provable exactness or exact rational output coordinates: CGAL's Nef/corefinement with an exact kernel stays the reference there
Non-manifold input: the half-edge structure cannot represent most non-manifold situations, so such meshes need repair first or the voxel mode
A small permissive dependency: Manifold (Apache-2.0) was only about 3x slower on the Nefertiti union and about as fast on the dental scan in the same benchmark

integration.dependencies: a large SDK with many third-party dependencies (not enumerated here); prebuilt packages via pip install meshlib, dotnet add package MeshLib and npm @meshinspector/meshlib, and C++ per the vendor's installation guide
integration.min_toolchain: not documented in the pages read
integration.thread_safety: not documented; booleans are internally multi-threaded by default

gotchas: Failures come back as an invalid BooleanResult with errorString, not as exceptions, so always check result.valid()

Floating-point classification bugs still turn up: PR #6861 fixed Union silently dropping a whole mesh when two meshes only touch (DifferenceBA gave negative volume), fixed with exact integer orient3d probing
Vendor timings vary across MeshLib's own pages: the boolean feature page lists a 1.2 s Nefertiti union, the 2026 blog 0.09 s with 3.1.3.249 on an M5. Benchmark your own version
Blender and Rhino give different (still watertight) results on self-intersecting input, so speed comparisons across libraries are not always like for like
pick_this_over_siblings_when: None of the catalogued siblings (TG, gDel3D, HXT, GeoToolbox KdBoxTree, nanoflann, tidwall rtree.c) does mesh booleans; MeshLib is the catalogue's mesh-CSG entry. Pick it when the task is a boolean on a large triangle mesh and the licence fits; otherwise look at Manifold.
verified_claims_summary: MeshInspector's own 2026 blog benchmark tested MeshLib 3.1.3.249 against CGAL, Manifold, MCut, CinoLib, libigl, Rhino and Blender via trimesh on an Apple M5 MacBook Air (10-core, 32 GB, macOS 26), taking the minimum of 10 runs with I/O excluded and default threading; compiler and flags are not stated. Union on 2M-triangle Nefertiti meshes: 0.09 s MeshLib, 0.27 s Manifold, 4.4 s CGAL (about 47x), 14 s Blender. On a degenerate dental scan MeshLib took 0.04 s while CGAL hung and MCut failed. The raw data is on a SharePoint link, and the post says the benchmark source 'will be opened publicly later'.
status_note: Very active (commits daily, about 826 stars, versioned releases), but source-available under a non-commercial/evaluation licence. It is reference-only for this catalogue and must not be copied into commercial code.
